meta.note: Every claim carries its artifact and a regeneration command that trusts nothing in this repo. Claims referencing Vibenet use the public RPC https://rpc.vibes.base.org.
disclosures: Vibenet is Base's experimental preview network; test tokens hold no monetary value.
tUSDC, fixed-price pools, and mock feeds on Vibenet are disclosed fixtures (src/testnet/Fixtures.sol).
WeftIndex is unaudited, solo-built, hackathon scope. No owner, no upgrades, no fees.
No dividend or split has ever executed on the Coinbase registry on Base mainnet; every mainnet multiplier reads 1.0 (verified claim C11).
Weights are fixed at creation; value weights drift with prices between deposits, like any index.

claims.claim: The two proof-run stock tokens are real B20 Asset-variant tokens created by the official factory precompile on Base Vibenet.
A 2% dividend was executed onchain: the B20 multiplier moved 1.00 to 1.02 via updateUIMultiplier, wrapped in a human-readable Announcement.
A 2-for-1 stock split was executed onchain: the wNVDA multiplier doubled 1.02 to 2.04.
Weaving 1,000 tUSDC minted 1,000 wPROOF shares and the index took real custody of the stock tokens (2.5 wAAPL, 5 wNVDA raw).
The dividend accrued to the index without touching raw balances: value moved 1000 to 1020 while raw holdings stayed 2.5/5.0.
The 2-for-1 split doubled the wNVDA leg's redemption and the basket value with it (1020 to 1530), raw balances still untouched.
Unwinding returned the full accrued value: 1,530 tUSDC (1,000 woven + 20 dividend + 510 split) with the entire supply burned to zero.

claims.claim: The Coinbase registry on Base mainnet is live and Weft reads it: the demo statement resolves real holdings, real trades, and real prices for a real holder address.
Mainnet liquidity for the first basket is real and measured: AAPLc/USDC $1.36M and NVDAc/USDC $2.64M on Aerodrome Slipstream (Sep 6 2026, GeckoTerminal).

claims.claim: The index contract enforces the mechanics the README promises: share math on deposit, per-leg slippage guards on redeem, stale-feed refusal, and weight-sum validation. 6/6 unit tests pass including a simulated 2% dividend accruing to holders.
